# Radxa / Third-Party Provenance

This directory documents third-party components and upstream projects relevant to the Radxa CM3 IO Ubuntu Server project.

## Radxa

The target hardware is the Radxa CM3 IO platform based on the Rockchip RK3566.

Radxa-provided board support, device trees, overlays, bootloader components and other software remain subject to their respective upstream licenses.

This repository does not claim ownership of Radxa source code or binaries.

## Ubuntu

The release image is based on Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS ARM64.

Ubuntu packages and associated components remain subject to their respective licenses and Ubuntu trademark policies.

## Linux

The release uses Linux 7.0.0-31-generic.

Linux kernel source and associated components retain their upstream licensing.

## Firmware

The release image contains firmware required by the tested hardware configuration. Firmware remains subject to the license terms provided by its respective copyright holders.

The tested Intel AX210 firmware is documented in the release manifest.

## Redistribution

Before redistributing individual third-party source packages, binaries or firmware separately from the release image, verify the applicable upstream license and redistribution requirements.
